intro: Caps in USDT on what Atlas may put into trades on the OKX demo account. The smallest limit always wins, here or in your risk profile.

prev.title: Next trade
prev.titleDraft: Next trade, with your unsaved changes

eq.cap: As of {{time}}, the account holds {{equity}}. Your bot capital cap lets Atlas size trades from {{sizing}} of it.
eq.stale: Equity last synced {{relative}}, at {{time}}. These figures use it until the next sync.
eq.capTail: Your bot capital cap lets Atlas size trades from {{sizing}} of it.

s.cap: With equity {{sizing}} (your bot capital cap), your next trade can risk at most {{risk}} and use at most {{use}}.
s.plain: With equity {{equity}}, your next trade can risk at most {{risk}} and use at most {{use}}.
s.trades: Atlas has made all {{n}} of today’s trades, so the next one waits until 00:00 Baghdad.
s.exposure: Today’s new exposure is used up, so the next trade waits until 00:00 Baghdad.

r.riskX: {{pct}} of {{sizing}}, the max loss per trade in your {{profile}} profile.
r.useX: Set by {{limit}}, the smallest of these limits.
r.tradesX: Every trade allowed today is made. The count resets at 00:00 Baghdad.

c.caption: This trade can use up to {{use}} of each.
c.captionZero: Nothing is left for a new trade today.
c.label: Limits on the next trade’s size

foot: Each trade is also checked against its instrument’s share, correlated positions, margin and leverage.
invalid: Fix the highlighted limit to update the preview.

noEq.title: No account equity yet
noEq.body: Atlas shows these limits in dollars once it has synced the OKX demo account’s equity. That happens about a minute after you connect.

pErr.title: The preview didn’t load
pErr.body: Your limits still save. Atlas couldn’t reach the preview service.

sub.cap: Atlas sizes trades as if the account held at most this. Your risk profile’s percentages apply to it.
sub.capNone: No cap, so Atlas sizes trades from the account’s full equity.
sub.trade: The largest position one trade can open, at full value rather than margin.
sub.day: {{used}} used today, {{left}} left. Resets at 00:00 Baghdad.
sub.dayUsed: Used up today. Resets at 00:00 Baghdad.
sub.dayNone: Nothing used today. Resets at 00:00 Baghdad.
sub.tradesAll: All {{n}} made today. Resets at 00:00 Baghdad.

note: Limits apply to new trades. Open positions keep their size.
noteProfile: Your {{profile}} profile’s max position, {{pct}} or {{value}}, is below these limits, so it sets the size.

err.digits: Use digits only, such as 3,000 or 2,500.50.
err.int: Enter a whole number from 1 to 1,000.

savedBody: The Risk Engine uses these limits from the next trade.
failedBody: Nothing changed. Try again in a moment.
fixFields: Fix the highlighted limit and save again.

conflict.title: These limits changed in another window
conflict.body: They are now version {{v}}. Your edits are kept on top of it; review them before saving.

activityNote: Every change is a new settings version. The Risk Engine reads the newest one before each trade.

error.title: Money limits didn’t load
error.body: Atlas couldn’t reach its settings. Check that it’s running with ./atlas up, then try again.

say: Next trade: risk at most {{risk}}, use at most {{use}}. {{binding}} sets the limit.
